subject: Deployment pathway & region timetable — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acme.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — deployment decision and MAP

Neha,

We need a concise mutual action plan for the hosting decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and a realistic close timeline. Key constraints from our side:
- Data residency for a subset of traffic must be US-only.
- Platform team needs an evaluation window (performance + security) of ~2-3 weeks for proof-of-concept.
- Procurement needs clear pricing bands and timing for reserved capacity if we go Dedicated.

Can your team put together a MAP with owners, evaluation tasks, and a recommended default path (we can always expand)? Ideally we want a decision by mid-September.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Director of Platform, ACME Corp
liam.oconnor@acme.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — deployment decision and MAP

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear ask. I've attached a first-draft MAP (ACME_MAP_v1.pdf) with proposed owners, evaluation milestones, and a decision timeline. High-level recommendation from our side:

- Phase 0 (fast path): Hosted in US-East for initial POC (2-week eval). Low friction and fastest time-to-value.
- Phase 1 (scale/commit): Dedicated for production throughput and predictable cost if POC shows sustained TPS; includes reserved capacity conversation.
- Phase 2 (regulated subset): Private deployment (VPC/on-prem or dedicated VPC) for the subset that requires strict data residency/controls.

I've put Marcus as SE owner for performance and Marissa for post-sales/operational readiness. Rishi will lead commercial timing and pricing bands.

Next sensible milestone: review the MAP together and lock owners by 2026-08-27 so we can run the POC week of 2026-09-06. Does that align with your team's availability?

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with timelines and owner matrix)

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acme.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — deployment decision and MAP

Neha,

Quick security note from our side as you prepare the MAP:
- We need a SOC2 artifact summary and list of what telemetry/logs Redwood collects for hosted mode.
- KMS/HSM support and key management options for Dedicated/Private.
- Data retention and deletion process for cached KV/prefixes used during inference.

I'll share a short checklist (attached) that our security team will use during the evaluation. If we move forward with Hosted for the POC, we still need the telemetry answers before we start.

Thanks,
Priya Desai
Security Lead, ACME Corp
priya.desai@acme.com

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_summary.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-26T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Next steps — deployment decision and MAP (technical eval plan)

Team —

I pulled together a technical evaluation plan to complement Neha's MAP. Key items and owners:

1) Latency & throughput matrix (SE) — Marcus Lin — run synthetic load vs target QPS, measure p95/p99 in US-East and US-West (2 days) — target complete by 2026-09-09.
2) Cost profile comparison (Commercial) — Rishi Malhotra — per-token and reserved capacity scenarios (3 days) — target 2026-09-03.
3) Security artifact handoff (Security) — Neha & Redwood Security — provide SOC2 summary and KMS options (1 week) — target 2026-08-31.
4) Integration smoke tests (Platform) — ACME Platform team + Redwood SE — test routing, fallback policies, and KV prefix isolation (3 days) — sprint 2026-09-06 to 09-08.
5) Data residency proof (Privacy) — Redwood Compliance — attest that subset routing to Private/VPC is enforceable; provide audit log example (4 days) — target 2026-09-02.

Preliminary recommendation on regions: start POC in US-East (closest to ACME customer base), run parallel latency checks in US-West. EU roll-out deferred to Phase 2 unless you need it sooner. For Dedicated sizing: initial reserve for 2x expected P99 throughput to avoid cold starts (we'll provide sizing guidance after the synthetic run).

I'll attach the evaluation checklist to the MAP doc in the drive. Please confirm owners so I can schedule the synthetic runs.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment pathway & region timetable — finalized MAP draft and decision window

Liam / Priya —

Thanks for the quick turn. Summarizing agreed MAP and next steps so we have one canonical plan: 

Mutual Action Plan (summary)
- Owners: Marcus (SE) — performance & synthetic runs; Rishi — commercial/pricing; Marissa — onboarding/operational runbook; Neha — MAP coordinator & sign-off owner.
- Security: Redwood to deliver SOC2 summary + KMS options by 2026-08-31 (Neha + Redwood Security).
- Eval window: Hosted POC in US-East — synthetic runs 2026-09-06 to 2026-09-08 (Marcus + ACME Platform).
- Decision target: ACME decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) by 2026-09-10. If Dedicated chosen, procurement/commit terms to follow; Redwood to provide reserved capacity quote by 2026-09-03.
- Private/regulated path: parallel work to scope Private/VPC for the regulated subset; deliverable: audit-log proof and KMS design doc by 2026-09-02.

Ask: Please reply-all with any changes to owners or dates by EOD 2026-09-01. If there are no changes we will treat this as the agreed MAP and proceed to schedule the POC.
